FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I register for a seat?+
You can contact us directly via phone at 9411577207. Visit us in person to see the library and confirm your seat with the monthly fee payment.
Is the library open on all days?+
We are open every day from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM, except on the last Sunday of each month.
Can girls also join the library?+
Absolutely! We have separate and clean washrooms for both boys and girls. The library is a safe, CCTV-monitored environment welcoming all students.
What is included in the ₹600 monthly fee?+
The fee covers your dedicated seat, personal charging point, reading light, RO drinking water, daily newspapers, the eating area, fiber internet, fully AC hall, and all general facilities. No hidden charges.
Is Wi-Fi available at the library?+
Yes! We have fiber speed internet available at the library for all members.
Can I visit before enrolling?+
Yes, we welcome you to visit the library during working hours to see the space and facilities before deciding. Just come in — no appointment needed!
